conflicting_marks.instructions: Does the applied candidate source in state implement this specific behavior? When manifest copies disagree on marks or attribution, the resolved marks remain the same when the input directory order is reversed. A stable canonical input order before merging can enforce this even if an individual map update keeps the first or last value. No particular conflict-resolution algorithm is required.
